answer.reason: The verses tell what was made, set up and used, which goes beyond the summary's location and purpose.

clauses.english: was made of brass from the women's mirrors who assembled at the tabernacle door
clauses.quote: he made the laver of brass, and the foot of it of brass

clauses.english: was set between the tent and the altar, where Moses, Aaron and his sons washed their hands and feet
clauses.quote: Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat

clauses.english: was anointed with oil and sanctified by Moses
clauses.quote: anointed the altar and all his vessels, both the laver and his foot, to sanctify them

doubts: The summary already states the position and the priests' washing, so the clause on its use rests on the account of its first use by Moses, Aaron and his sons.
Three clauses may be more than a furnishing needs; the anointing could be dropped.
